description: Returns a company's income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement as filed with the SEC in XBRL: the last 12 calendar quarters or 6 fiscal years, with the filing behind each period. Use it when the user asks for revenue, earnings, balance sheet or cash flow over several periods. A null is a line not filed for that period: report it as unknown; computed lines say how (`computed`); cash outflows are negative; amounts are in the filing currency. A foreign issuer filing once a year (20-F) has fiscal years, plus its quarters when it files them as Form 6-K (`audited: false`); TSMC's monthly revenue, quarterly results and guidance are in `releases`. Also: `revenueBy` (revenue by segment, geography and product, as the company's own tables add up) and `customerConcentration` (customers it discloses, with their share of revenue) — statement=breakdowns; `guidance`, `actualVsGuidance` and `nextEarnings` (estimated) — statement=outlook; with the balance sheet, `debtComposition` (debt instrument by instrument, with the filed maturity schedule). A company not listed yet that filed a public prospectus (pre-IPO, e.g. 'anthropic') returns its prospectus statements, by half year by default.

basis.description: quarterly (default for a listed company: last 12 calendar quarters), half (half years: a company before its IPO only — its default) or annual (last 6 fiscal years).

statement.description: income, balance, cashflow, breakdowns (revenue by segment, geography and product, and customer concentration), outlook (the company's guidance, actuals against it, next earnings date) or all (default all).

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.

name: get_financials
title: Financial statements as filed
